steps.title: Bem-vindo: Shopping - Volume 50
steps.text: In this C2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Shopping". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: You can pay in twelve installments.
This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
The cashier gave me the wrong change.

steps.text: It means: "Something very easy to do.". Say the example sentence out loud:
